title: Kala Chashma
artist: Amar Arshi, Badshah, Neha Kakkar, Indeep Bakshi

lines.text: Tenu dekh ke haunke bharde ne
Jo daag hai chan de tukde te
Sadko pe chale jab ladkon ke dilon mein
Tu aag laga de baby fire
Kala kala chashma jachta tere mukhde pe
Jaisa kala til jachta hai tere chin pe
Apni adaaon se zyaada nahi toh dus baraah
Ladke toh maar hi deti hogi tu din mein
Mere vargi aur na honi ve
(Var var vargi aur na honi ve)
Haaye main fed up ho gaiyaa mundeya
Haaye main fed up ho gaiyaa mundeya
Sunn sunn ke tere dukhde ve
Ho mainu kala kala kala kala kala kala
Ho mainu kala chashma jachda ae
Sadko pe chale jab ladkon ke dilon mein
O kala kala kala kala kala
